visibility: repository-local; not a public API projection.
purpose: Repository-local context for AI-assisted structured block authoring.

contentPolicy.persistence: Gutenberg attributes only; Astro owns final frontend markup.
contentPolicy.compatibility: Legacy reads are accepted for old content; editors write canonical names only.

fieldConventions.media: Pair numeric media IDs with source/URL and alt-text attributes; mark the source field ui.kind media.
fieldConventions.links: Mark editable links ui.kind url and store the URL as content, not rendered markup.
fieldConventions.repeaters: Declare row properties and required fields in the array item contract.
fieldConventions.metadata: schemaVersion and blockId are contract metadata and hidden from generic editors.

nativeContent.boundary: Use native blocks for simple flexible editorial sections; custom getquick/* blocks remain registration-owned.
nativeContent.limitation: Conversion can fall back to core/html; native validation does not validate Nomia attributes or Astro renderers.

levels.establishes: Registration shape, generated projections, and cross-application parity.
The block preview route renders the fixture through the real Astro dispatcher.
The tracked plugin registration and PHP test surfaces pass.
Saved RAW block comments parse into contract-valid attributes.
The complete gate covers build, CMS, browser preview, and packaging behavior.

verification.limitation: A passing contract check does not prove editor persistence or production behavior.
